response.sql:
WITH category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining,
        SUM(amount - spent) AS total_difference
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount > 75
    GROUP BY category
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_difference) AS average_total
    FROM category_totals
)
SELECT
    ct.category,
    ct.average_remaining,
    ct.total_difference,
    ct.total_difference - oa.average_total AS above_average
FROM category_totals AS ct
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE oa.average_total IS NOT NULL
  AND ct.total_difference > oa.average_total;

assumptions.assumption: Treat the 75-dollar cutoff as strictly greater than 75, and interpret “ignoring missing values” as excluding NULL inputs from AVG and SUM; SUM is NULL for a category with no non-NULL differences, and such totals are omitted from the overall average.
